settings.hero_desc: A graceful classical bust of a woman in the Greek tradition, sculpted with soft, flowing detail and a clean stone-look finish. A timeless decorative sculpture for interiors, studios and galleries - made in the size and finish you choose.
settings.s1_body: This classical female bust brings a sense of calm, timeless beauty to any space. Sculpted in the Greek tradition with soft features and flowing hair, and finished in a clean stone look, it makes an elegant centrepiece for a console, shelf or studio. Choose your size and finish, and we can recreate other classical busts and figures in the same style.
settings.case_body: Produced as a decorative sculpture for Espire Hospitality Reception, this classical bust brings museum-style elegance into a modern interior - a calm, timeless focal point made to the size and finish a space calls for.
settings.case_quote: Beautifully sculpted - it brings a real sense of calm and class to the room.
settings.prov_p: Classical sculpture has defined ideals of beauty for thousands of years. A faithful bust brings that timeless elegance into your own home, at whatever scale suits your space.
